subject: OCCURS clause
notes: kb/Work PB565 (2026-09-13). Rule 16 is stated for FORMATS 2 AND 3 and both arms now enforce it: the data-division occurs-depending table in DataBinder.Odo (COBOL0852, long-standing) and the report-writer repeating entry in ReportOccursOf, which rejects integer-1 < 0 or integer-2 <= integer-1 with COBOL2021 before the entry is replayed. The report arm could not exist before this landing because an OCCURS clause in a report group description entry was refused by name (COBOL0899), so rule 16 had no report-section population at all: the format-3 half of the rule was unimplemented, not merely untested.
